benchmark: per-(market_id, token_id) buy-side VWAP (Paper 1 main analysis benchmark)
methodology: Fair-price benchmark: per-(market_id, token_id) volume-weighted average price across BUY-side trades only (Paper 1 main analysis). P&L attributed to BOTH maker AND taker with mirror signs so dollar totals sum to zero across all wallet types per week. Bps fields are ROI = pnl / usd_volume in basis points (x10000).
